listings.title: 2009 Sedan — MINT CONDITION — Runs Like New — Must See
listings.body:
MINT CONDITION. Runs like new. Garage kept. Lady driven. Never smoked in.

[b]Mileage:[/b] 280,412

Serious buyers only. No lowballers I know what I have.

listings.title: Estate sale — workshop tools, 47 Pellam Road, Saturday 9am
listings.body:
My husband Ray died in June. He kept a workshop in the garage for thirty-one years and I have to be out of the house by the end of October.

I am not good at this so I am going to just list what is there.

[list][*]Table saw, old but he serviced it every spring[*]Two tool chests, full[*]Pillar drill[*]Wood clamps, a lot of them, I stopped counting at forty[*]Jars of screws and fittings, sorted by size in his handwriting[*]Workbench, he built it, it is very heavy and I cannot move it so it is free to anyone who can[/list]

I do not know what any of it is worth. If you know what it is worth please tell me honestly, my son says people will not.

Saturday from 9am. There is coffee. 47 Pellam Road, Ashkettle.

listings.title: FREE upright piano — you collect — needs tuning — genuinely free
listings.body:
Upright piano, dark wood, 1950s something, no maker's plate left on it. It has been in the front room since we bought the house in 2011 and the previous owners left it because they could not move it either.

It plays. Two keys near the top are dead and the whole thing is about a semitone flat. A tuner told me it is worth tuning and not worth restoring.

It is FREE. I am not going to ask you for anything. It weighs something like 250kg and it is up three steps from the street, so bring at least four people and straps. If you turn up with two people and a hatchback I will make you tea and you will go home without a piano.

If nobody takes it by the 30th it goes to the dump and I would rather it did not.

I am currently working as a missionary abroad and cannot show the property in person. The keys are with a courier service. To arrange viewing please send first month rent and deposit via bank transfer and the keys will be released within 24 hours.

God bless. Complete the tenancy form here: [url=synth://verity-rentals-secure.keyrelease.click/apply]verity-rentals-secure[/url]

listings.title: 2016 Pickup, 4WD, tow bar, 141k, honest description inside
listings.body:
Selling my pickup because I have stopped doing the job I bought it for.

141,000 miles. 4WD works, I use it every winter. Tow bar fitted 2019. Service history from 2018 onward, nothing before that because I bought it at auction.

What is wrong with it: the tailgate handle sticks, there is a dent in the rear passenger door from a gate, the driver's seat bolster is worn through, and it uses about a litre of oil between services. I have not fixed any of that and the price reflects it.

Happy for you to take it to a garage of your choosing before you buy. I will come with you.

listings.title: Room in shared house, Marchfield, working tenant preferred
listings.body:

$390 a month, bills split three ways, usually comes to about $70 each in winter and less in summer.

The house is old and the back bedroom is cold. I am telling you now rather than after you move in. Good landlord, fixes things within a week.

No deposit until you have seen the room. Come and see the room.

listings.title: Estate sale — Ray's model railway, 00 gauge, Verity Rail branch layout
listings.body:
This is the second of my listings. This one is harder.

Ray built a model of the branch line as it ran in 1974, from Ashkettle up to the junction. It takes up the whole spare bedroom on a board he made in sections so it could be moved. He worked on it from 1998 until this March.

The buildings are scratch built from photographs. The signal box is right down to the window frames. Two of the men from [url=synth://forums.verityrail.org/]forums.verityrail.org[/url] came to see it in 2019 and one of them cried, which Ray talked about for a year.

I would rather it went to someone who will keep it together than be sold off in pieces. If that is you, come on Saturday and tell me what you would do with it. Money matters less than that.

If nobody wants it whole, then I will sell it in pieces, and that is all right too.

listings.title: Kitchen porter, evenings, New Carrow — real job, real pay

No experience needed. We have trained four people from nothing in two years and two of them are still here.

Come in and ask for Denise. Do not email, we do not check it.

listings.title: Bicycle, hybrid, 21 speed, needs new chain
listings.body:

listings.title: Estate sale — the rest of the house, 47 Pellam Road
listings.body:
Third and last listing.

Everything else. Beds, wardrobes, the kitchen table, a chest freezer that works, curtains, about two hundred books, a box of LPs, garden furniture, a lawnmower he swore at every summer.

Some of it I want gone and some of it I am going to find hard to watch leave, and I will not know which is which until you pick it up. If I say no to something on the day, please do not take it personally.

A man messaged me offering $900 for the entire contents of the house sight unseen and said he could come Thursday. I have said no. I would rather it went slowly to people from round here.

Saturday 9am, 47 Pellam Road, Ashkettle.

listings.title: Two bed cottage to let, Halsey, long let preferred, no agency
listings.body:
Stone cottage, two bedrooms, small yard at the back. Oil heating, tank was filled in August.

It is a cottage from 1890 and it behaves like one. The upstairs windows rattle when the wind comes off the flats and there is no room for a dishwasher.

I let it to the same family for nine years and I would like another long let. One month deposit, no agency, no application fee, I do not use those services.

Come and look at it before you decide anything.

listings.title: Solar Generator Kit — EMERGENCY POWER — Grid Failure Ready — Limited
listings.body:

Complete solar generator kit. Panel, battery, inverter, cables.

Capacity figures on the box are peak instantaneous and should not be used for planning.

See also our listings for water filtration and long-life food. Limited stock, price rises Monday. Every Monday.

listings.title: Someone to sit with my father two afternoons a week
listings.body:
My father is 84 and lives alone in Halsey. He is mostly fine. He forgets the middle of the day.

I need someone to be in the house Tuesday and Thursday afternoons, roughly 1pm to 5pm, while I am at work. Not nursing. Making tea, being there, watching the racing with him and letting him tell you about the rail yard, which he will, every week, the same story.

$18 an hour cash, and I will not mess you about on hours.

I would prefer someone local who can meet him first and see if they get on. He does not like new people on the phone but he is different in person.

listings.body:
